title: Opening Parameters of Each Savings and Money Market Tier
content:
Savings & Money Market Accounts are offered by Piedmont Crescent Bank in six tiers, and each tier carries its own opening parameters. Four parameters are set per tier: the minimum opening deposit, being the smallest first deposit that funds and activates a new account of that tier; the checking tiers of which the customer must already hold an active account in order to open the tier; the youngest and the oldest age in whole years, measured on the opening date, at which the customer may open the tier as sole owner; and the greatest number of open accounts of that tier one customer may hold.

## Parameters by tier

| Tier | Minimum opening deposit | Checking tier required to open | Youngest age to open | Oldest age to open | Most open accounts of this tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 25.00 USD | none | 18 years | no maximum | 2 |
| Statement Savings | 100.00 USD | none | 18 years | no maximum | 3 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 50.00 USD | none | 18 years | no maximum | 5 |
| Money Market Account | 2500.00 USD | none | 18 years | no maximum | 2 |
| Premier Money Market | 10000.00 USD | none | 18 years | no maximum | 2 |
| Private Client Money Market | 25000.00 USD | Private Client Checking | 18 years | no maximum | 2 |

## Notes on the parameters

Age is counted in whole years as at the opening date, from the date of birth carried on the customer profile. No tier of this product sets an oldest age: the parameter reads no maximum throughout.

Private Client Money Market is the only tier whose opening parameters name a checking tier. For every other tier the parameter reads none, so no checking holding enters the opening parameters at all.

The account cap is a per-tier figure and differs across the range: Goal Builder Savings carries the widest cap at 5 open accounts of that tier, Statement Savings 3, and each of the remaining four tiers 2.

## Illustrative selection of tiers by first deposit

Take a hypothetical first deposit of 5000.00 USD. Read against the table above, that figure reaches the minimum opening deposit of Starter Savings, Statement Savings, Goal Builder Savings and Money Market Account, and falls short of the 10000.00 USD set for Premier Money Market and the 25000.00 USD set for Private Client Money Market. A hypothetical first deposit of 40.00 USD reaches only the 25.00 USD parameter of Starter Savings.
